sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Historical phonology and lexicon only; sole stress remark is diachronic: the vowel before OIr. *-ka was deleted 'be-dalil-e bi-takye budan-e heja'i ke in vakeha dar an qarar dashte-and' (because the syllable containing it was unstressed). No synchronic placement rule.

sources.citation: Ivanow, W. 1930. Notes on the Dialect of Khur and Mihrijan. Acta Orientalia 8: 45-61.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No placement rule. p.46: 'Occasionally there are differences in accent, and different individuals usually render the same word differently'; p.48: vowels 'particularly elusive in their tone or timbre, unless sharply accented'; p.48: rušna (= LP raushan) 'with a strange transfer of the accent'.
